provenance: Project-authored concise help for the implemented compatibility subset.

assoc.stdout: ASSOC [.extension[=type]]: inspect or update session file associations.

break.stdout: BREAK [ON|OFF]: store the compatibility break setting.

call.stdout: CALL script [arguments] or CALL :label [arguments]: execute and return to the caller.

cd.stdout: CD [/D] [directory]: inspect or change the working directory.

chdir.stdout: CD [/D] [directory]: inspect or change the working directory.

cls.stdout: CLS: clear the console; captured output receives a form-feed character.

color.stdout: COLOR [hex]: select console foreground and background colors.

copy.stdout: COPY [/Y|/-Y] source destination: copy file data.

dpath.stdout: DPATH [path]: inspect or update the session search path.

echo.stdout: ECHO [ON|OFF|text]: control command echoing or write text. ECHO( writes a blank line.

endlocal.stdout: ENDLOCAL: restore the environment saved by SETLOCAL.

exit.stdout: EXIT [/B] [code]: leave the current shell or batch context.

for.stdout: FOR %V IN (items) DO command: iterate values. Use %%V in batch files. /L iterates numbers; /F parses text.

ftype.stdout: FTYPE [type[=command]]: inspect or update session file-type commands.

goto.stdout: GOTO label: jump within the current batch file. GOTO :EOF returns from it.

if.stdout: IF [NOT] condition command [ELSE command]: branch on comparisons, EXIST, DEFINED or ERRORLEVEL.

keys.stdout: KEYS: compatibility command; interactive key handling depends on the console backend.

md.stdout: MD directory: create a directory and any missing parents.

mkdir.stdout: MD directory: create a directory and any missing parents.

mklink.stdout: MKLINK [/D|/H|/J] link target: request a host-supported filesystem link.

move.stdout: MOVE [/Y|/-Y] source destination: move files or directories.

path.stdout: PATH [paths]: inspect or replace the command search path.

pause.stdout: PAUSE: wait for an input key.

popd.stdout: POPD: restore the last directory saved by PUSHD.

prompt.stdout: PROMPT [text]: set the interactive prompt format.

pushd.stdout: PUSHD directory: save the working directory and enter another directory.

rem.stdout: REM text: a batch comment; surrounding syntax is still parsed.

ren.stdout: REN source destination: rename a file or directory.

rename.stdout: REN source destination: rename a file or directory.

set.stdout: SET [name=[value]]: inspect or change variables. SET /A evaluates integer arithmetic; SET /P reads a line.

shift.stdout: SHIFT [/n]: advance numbered batch arguments, optionally starting at n.

start.stdout: START ["title"] [/WAIT] command: launch a child command within supported process options.

title.stdout: TITLE text: set the console title.

type.stdout: TYPE file: write file contents to standard output.

ver.stdout: VER: display the virtual compatibility version.

verify.stdout: VERIFY [ON|OFF]: inspect or store the compatibility verification setting.

vol.stdout: VOL [drive:]: display basic virtual volume information.
